auth_change_email_bad_link: Invalid link. Missing token or email.
auth_change_email_done_text: Your email has been updated successfully.
auth_forgot_failed: We couldn't process your request right now. Please try again.
auth_forgot_lead: Enter your email and we will send reset instructions.
auth_forgot_sent: If an account exists for this email, you will receive reset instructions shortly.
auth_reset_done_text: Your password has been changed successfully.
auth_reset_remove_devices_note: For an account someone else may have used: every device signs out and comes off your account. Setting one up again takes your recovery key.
auth_session_not_renewed: The main window didn't renew the session in time
auth_sign_in_lead: Sign in to continue to Duvet.
auth_sign_up_lead: a cozy place to talk, and you're about to join it.
auth_sign_up_password_label: {count, plural, one {Password, at least # character} other {Password, at least # characters}}
auth_terms_agree: I agree to the <terms>Terms of use</terms>
auth_terms_text: By creating an account, you agree to follow community guidelines and use Duvet respectfully.
auth_username_hint: Letters, numbers, dots and _, 2 to 32. It's how people mention you.
auth_verify_done_text: Your email has been verified successfully.
e2e_before_joining: Messages from before you joined aren't on this device. Any member can share them.
e2e_blocked: This conversation can't go on securely.
e2e_change_keys_confirm: Make new security keys and a new recovery key for your account? Your contacts will see that your keys changed.
e2e_change_keys_line: New security keys and a new recovery key, for when a device of yours or your recovery key may be in someone else's hands.
e2e_change_unanswered: No answer came yet: Duvet tries again on its own.
e2e_change_waits: Another change of this group is still going through. Try again in a moment.
e2e_cutover: Messages from before end-to-end encryption were deleted on {date}
e2e_delete_device: Remove this device and delete its data
e2e_delete_device_confirm: Delete this device's encrypted conversations and their keys, and sign out?
e2e_delete_device_line: Deletes this device's encrypted conversations and their keys, and signs you out.
e2e_delete_listed_device_confirm: Delete this device's encrypted conversations and their keys, and sign out? Without your recovery key, their history is lost unless another of your devices still holds it. This device stays on your device list until you remove it on another device.
e2e_delete_only_device_confirm: This is your only device with your encrypted conversations: without your recovery key, their history is lost. Delete them and their keys, and sign out?
e2e_delete_refused: Your message couldn't be deleted for everyone.
e2e_device_action_failed: Couldn't change your devices. Check your connection, then try again.
e2e_device_added: A new device was added to your account: {name}.
e2e_device_lost: It was lost or stolen: change my security keys too
e2e_device_lost_note: With new keys, whoever has it can't add devices to your account or read what's sent from now on. You'll save a new recovery key, and your contacts see that your keys changed.
e2e_device_remove_along: This also removes {names}, whose earlier removal didn't finish.
e2e_device_remove_text: It's signed out, and reads none of your encrypted conversations from now on.
e2e_devices_lead: Each place you're signed in to Duvet. Those on your device list read your encrypted conversations.
e2e_edit_refused: Your edit couldn't be saved for everyone.
e2e_failed: Encrypted conversations couldn't open on this device.
e2e_file_altered: This file isn't the one its sender sent, so it isn't shown.
e2e_file_download_failed: Couldn't download this file. Try again.
e2e_files_gone: This message's files aren't on this device any more. Dismiss it, then send them again.
e2e_first_device: Set up end-to-end encryption for your direct messages.
e2e_first_device_finish: Finish setting up end-to-end encryption for your direct messages.
e2e_group_full: A group can have 20 members at most.
e2e_inactive_warning: {device} hasn't connected in over 45 days. Remove it if you don't use it.
e2e_leave_elsewhere: This device can't leave this group yet. Leave from another of your devices.
e2e_locked: Encrypted conversations are open in another Duvet window.
e2e_lost_key: Your encrypted conversations can't be opened on this device: its key is gone.
e2e_members_blocked: This device can't change who's in this conversation yet.
e2e_members_changed: This conversation's members changed since you last saw it.
e2e_new_device: Set up this device to read your encrypted conversations.
e2e_no_device: {name} can't receive encrypted messages yet. Your device will pass them on when they can.
e2e_no_e2e_here: Direct messages aren't available in this app yet. Use Duvet on the web.
e2e_not_ready: Encrypted conversations aren't ready on this device
e2e_paused: Encrypted conversations are paused. Your message will be sent when they're back.
e2e_recovery_failed: Your keys couldn't be saved. Check your connection, then try again.
e2e_recovery_why: It's the only way to read your encrypted conversations on a new device if you don't have this one. Keep it somewhere safe: Duvet can't show it again.
e2e_remove_failed: Couldn't remove them from the group
e2e_removed_device: This device was removed from your account.
e2e_restart_leaves_out: Restarting leaves out {names}, who are no longer in this conversation.
e2e_rotation_stuck: This change of your security keys can't finish: another of your devices changed your devices or keys meanwhile, and the recovery key it showed won't work. To use encrypted conversations here again, delete this device's data and set it up again.
e2e_rotation_why: Your security keys changed, and with them your recovery key. Keep this one somewhere safe: Duvet can't show it again.
e2e_search_split: In an encrypted conversation, pinned: and has:sticker can't be combined with words or with has:image, video or sound.
e2e_share_history_failed: Couldn't share the history. Try again.
e2e_share_history_limit: You can share history 10 times an hour. Try again {when}.
e2e_share_history_line: {name} gets the messages this device holds from the time you pick, marked as shared by you.
e2e_share_history_no_device: {name} has no device that can receive it yet.
e2e_share_history_truncated: Not all of it fit: {name} gets the messages from {date} on.
e2e_shared: {a} shared {range, select, day {the last 24 hours} week {the last 7 days} month {the last 30 days} other {the conversation's history}} with {b}
e2e_shared_add_failed: Couldn't add the shared messages. Try again.
e2e_shared_with_you: {a} shared {range, select, day {the last 24 hours} week {the last 7 days} month {the last 30 days} other {the conversation's history}} with you
e2e_start_over_confirm: Delete this device's encrypted conversations and their keys, and set it up again as a new device? Your other devices keep theirs.
e2e_storage_not_kept: This browser didn't agree to keep this device's encrypted data: it may delete it when space runs low, and this browser would then be a new device.
e2e_too_many_waiting: Too many messages wait to be sent here: send or dismiss them first
e2e_unsupported_browser: This browser can't open encrypted conversations.
e2e_wait_owner: Waiting for {owner} to open this group
e2e_wait_rejoin: You'll be back in this conversation when another member opens it.
e2e_waiting_detail: It will show up when the sender's device delivers it.
public_download_lead: Once installed, the app keeps itself up to date.
public_download_other_systems: macOS, Linux and Android are on their way. Meanwhile, Duvet works in the browser at duvet.chat.
public_invite_expired: This invite is invalid or has expired.
public_invite_join_failed: We couldn't join this Space. Please try again.
public_invite_sign_in_note: Sign in to join this Space.
settings_language_note: Duvet's menus, buttons and notices. Messages stay as people wrote them. Saved on this device.
settings_sign_out_text: Your encrypted conversations stay on this device for when you sign in again.
